children: on Friday a new Lloyd's syndicate for reinsurance capacity.

Cortina syndicate 1956 will provide dedicated, multi-year reinsurance capacity, broaden the capital available to clients, and support the continued growth and resilience of the reinsurance marketplace.
The syndicate received Lloyd's Council's "in principle" approval on October 16, and is expected to receive the permission to underwrite from January 1, 2027.
Cortina is set to complement traditional reinsurers through a conventional "lead/follow" approach.
"As risks grow in scale and complexity, clients are looking for effective risk transfer solutions that consider all forms of available capital," said Greg Case, CEO of Aon.

"Cortina is bringing additional, long-term capital through Blackstone together with QBE's expertise and the strength of Lloyd's to expand the market's capacity to take risk, help close protection gaps and enable greater resilience, investment and growth," said Case.
"Cortina is a first-of-its-kind model for reinsurance capacity at Lloyd's," said Jason Harris, QBE International

"As managing agent, we bring deep, specialist underwriting expertise and our leading Lloyd's capability to a syndicate that combines long-term institutional capital with stable, disciplined reinsurance capacity. It also gives us the opportunity to further grow our business through an innovative model."

title: Blackstone funds, Aon team up to launch new Lloyd's syndicate for reinsurance
